decisions.reason: Area elastic sports flooring builds on an established sports-floor competence with long project cycles, so the firm is likely to keep it despite its residential focus.
Mobile arena floors are a specialised niche with steady demand from event and sports venues, and the firm's existing know-how supports continuing the line.
This second mobile arena system may overlap with Product B, which makes consolidation possible, but it likely serves distinct venue needs and is retained for now.
Chevron parquet is a flagship that fits the firm's trend-led, natural-aesthetic direction exactly, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The squash court finish is a small add-on that costs little to keep and completes the sports offer.
Oak skirting is a low-cost accessory that supports sales of the sports floor systems.
